pd.population: Detection probability is the fraction of jammed cells inside the scheduled allocation that are flagged on the test split, pooling TDL-A and TDL-C. Thresholds target 1% per-cell false alarms on validation. Curves are means over training seeds 0, 1, and 2; the hover text and the table give the standard deviation over the seeds.

margin.population: The fused U-Net's smallest margin over pilot, data, and partial-band jamming on the scheduled PRBs is the JSR at 10% standard-receiver BLER minus the JSR at 90% slot detection. Slot detection averages over training seeds 0, 1, and 2. Its JSR grid runs from −30 to 0 dB at 15 dB SNR and from −36 to 0 dB at 5, 8, and 11 dB SNR, in 3 dB steps. The 1% and 0.1% per-slot false-alarm thresholds are calibrated on every other benign batch in each margin split, starting with the first. The remaining benign batches measure the false-alarm rate. The 95% intervals use a stratified batch bootstrap with binomial resampling of block errors. Open markers give upper bounds where slot detection did not reach 90% on the tested JSR grid.

recovery.population: Block error rate (BLER) pools block errors and decoded blocks across detector training seeds 0, 1, and 2 at +9 dB JSR on TDL-C at 15 dB SNR with known noise power. The allocation spans 12 PRBs and the jammer occupies 4 PRBs when active. Receivers share the same draws but can stop at different block counts. The paired 95% intervals use only slots decoded by both receivers, so their BLER differences can differ from the pooled table.

recovery_curves.population: Block error rate (BLER) pools block errors and decoded blocks over detector training seeds 0, 1, and 2 on TDL-C at 15 dB SNR with known noise power. The nominal jammer sweep spans −15 to +9 dB JSR and includes a benign reference. The UE occupies 12 PRBs. The jammer occupies 4 PRBs for pilot, data, and partial-band jamming and all 12 PRBs for whole-allocation pilot jamming.

matched.population: On the nominal test split, thresholds are fitted by attack and detector to flag 1% of scored clean cells, rounded down to a whole cell. F1 uses all cell decisions. Detection probability uses jammed scheduled cells at the weakest tested JSR. The values average over training seeds 0, 1, and 2. The 95% batch-bootstrap intervals hold the matched decisions fixed.

data_aided.population: Pilot jamming of every DMRS cell of the 12-PRB allocation (PRBs 6-17), TDL-C, known noise power; at 8 dB SNR also data and partial-band jamming of 4 PRBs. Errors pool detector training seeds 0, 1, and 2, up to 1,600 slots each; a receiver stops after 100 block errors, so denominators differ. Data-aided: up to three passes after a failed decoding, in which the decoded symbols of the data cells the map calls clean act as extra pilots; a block keeps the first decoding whose CRC passes. The paired CSVs give each difference with a 95% interval on the slots both receivers decoded.
data_aided.summary: With every pilot of the allocation jammed there is no clean pilot to estimate the channel from. At 15 dB SNR, data-aided passes lower the BLER with the U-Net map from 39.3% to 24.4% at +9 dB JSR and from 3.6% to 1.3% at +3 dB; the same passes without a map reach 37.9% and 2.3%. At 8 dB SNR, data and partial-band jamming of 4 PRBs still leave 3.9–10.3% BLER with the map; the passes lower it to 2.9–7.8%. Without a map they change little there, because they then also treat jammed data cells as pilots. With every pilot jammed at 8 dB SNR and +3 dB JSR, the passes without a map end lower than with it (3.6% against 4.1%).

dmrs.population: One DMRS symbol per slot against two (symbols 2 and 11). The U-Nets are trained on their own DMRS configuration; the block test and the EVM threshold are calibrated on the matching validation data. F1 and false alarms cover the whole carrier of the test split; Pd counts the jammed cells inside the allocation at −15 dB JSR. U-Net values average training seeds 0, 1, and 2. BLER pools the same seeds at +9 dB JSR on TDL-C at 15 dB SNR with the UE on 12 PRBs and the jammer on 4. In the last row the jammer assumes one front-loaded DMRS symbol and jams only the first.

width_sweep.population: BLER with the jammer on 2-12 of the UE's 12 PRBs (PRBs 6-17), a block placed at random inside the allocation, so it covers that share of the UE's pilots (pilot and partial-band jamming) and data cells (data and partial-band jamming); TDL-C, 15 dB SNR, known noise power, at -3, +3 and +9 dB JSR. Errors pool detector training seeds 0, 1, and 2, up to 1,600 slots each; a receiver stops after 100 block errors, so denominators differ. Detection: Pd of the fused U-Net on the test split, whose jammer blocks are 2-12 PRBs wide anywhere on the carrier, grouped by the block's width; jammed cells inside the allocation, means over training seeds 0, 1, and 2 with 1% per-cell false alarms on validation.
